dog.description_text:
Traveling all the way from California, Luciana and her sister came to ARF to find their perfect homes! This adorable, scruffy little pup may be a little reserved when you first meet her, but give her a little time and she’ll warm up quickly. Once she feels comfortable, Luciana is ready to show you her sweet personality!
With a little patience, some training, and a lot of love, Luciana is sure to blossom into a wonderful companion and the perfect addition to her forever home.
